description: Ministry  of  Highways & Road Development   -  Order, declare the Outer Circular Highway  as a National Highway
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a road as a National Highway under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It is a regulatory action that modifies the legal status of infrastructure, includes detailed technical specifications and schedules, and rescinds a previous order. While a minister's name is present, the core content is about establishing a legal/regulatory framework for transportation infrastructure, not about government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "legal notices."
